title: Rains sounds so different as droplets dance on leaves singing for the first time. #poemsofpresence #smallpoems
summary: Rains sounds so different as droplets dance on leaves singing for the first time. #poemsofpresence #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Rains sounds
  so
     different
as droplets
   dance
on leaves
    singing for
the first
   time.
#poemsofpresence
#smallpoems
